story: hey-native-apps, 2026-11-03, stall #10147. 24 pull requests were queued and two of them each broke the build by itself. The old queue went 114 minutes without a landing and people stepped in. The case queues them together, so they line up by number: the culprits are 2nd and 5th. Every build with the first fails, so finding it says nothing about the second, and the queue has to look again once the first is out.
